license_policy: Modules in this group are independent rewrites. The reference is a decompiled third-party translation tool that bundles a GARbro-derived namespace family plus self-written handlers. GARbro is GPL-3.0; the bundled copy's exact commit and the self-written handlers' terms are unconfirmed, so all rewrites ship as GPL-3.0-only and no source lines were copied. Every module is validated with synthetic fixtures only; no game assets were used.

reference_tool.name: translation-helper v4.9D
reference_tool.form: decompiled .NET research copy (not shipped, not executed)
reference_tool.notes: Only structure and parameter values were read. The tool has no in-game verification record of its own.

entries.license_status: Self-written handler inside the tool; no license statement found.
deviations: Overlong text is refused instead of truncated.
Padding joins the same cipher pass so a shortened slot decrypts to text plus spaces.
Tables must end on a known section boundary; a failed parse advances one byte instead of trusting the tag.
Out-of-range reads raise instead of being clamped to the remaining bytes.
Overlong text is refused instead of being cut mid-character.
parseStringByStruct is not ported because the reference export path never calls it.
Unknown opcodes abort at a boundary instead of resynchronising.
The image walk must consume the payload exactly.
Chunk names must be unique and ASCII.
The fixed placeholder index size written by the reference packer is not copied.
Only mode A is written; mode S is read-only because the reference never packed it.
Member bounds and the zlib stream are validated exactly.
The original name width and offset layout are preserved on rebuild.
The record layout must end exactly at the declared index size.
Paged members are rotated back only when the marker and block bounds are consistent.

entries.license_status: Self-written handler inside the tool; no license statement found.
deviations: No debug dialogs, hardcoded section indexes or in-place buffer mutation.
The key table is supplied by the caller instead of being read from a fixed path.
Section table entries are validated before any payload is read.
The LZSS encoder does not assume a 2x output buffer.
The legacy 32-byte-name directory is read-only because the reference UI never calls it.
AI6WIN names must be NUL terminated inside the 260-byte slot.
The index offset is recomputed from the size-prefixed bin layout instead of a running counter that double counts.
Member paths keep their original separators instead of being rewritten to backslashes.
SNR edits replace only selected lines, so a no-op is byte identical.
AES is a new standard-library implementation checked against FIPS-197 and SP 800-38A vectors.
IndexOf returning -1 no longer feeds a length computation; unterminated strings raise.
The DAT writer derives the index size from the member count.
SDT spans are reported as candidates and the reader states it is not a disassembler.

entries.license_status: Self-written handler inside the tool; no license statement found.
deviations: 234..490 is a parse boundary only; text append stays limited to the version with real round-trip tests.
Non-482 scripts are recorded as unsupported_version with member bytes preserved.

entries.license_status: Self-written handler inside the tool; no license statement found.
deviations: The three address dialects are detected explicitly instead of relying on a file dialog for the missing .ari.
Addresses must be non-negative, unique and inside the file; the reference trusts them.
The fixed-slot writer re-reads the archive and compares every address, length and byte.
not_ported: variable-length reflow that would move absolute addresses
